events.body:
## Context

`src/index_template.py:3-4` and `src/worker.py` say the page is "auto-generated from templates/index.html" and to regenerate before deploying, but no generator exists (`scripts/` has only `run-migrations.sh` and `upload-production-vars.sh`). The two copies have drifted: the live module has the Admin link and "Live" badge, the template doesn't.

## What to do

1. Treat the live `src/index_template.py` HTML as canonical and copy it back into `templates/index.html`.
2. Add `scripts/build_index_template.py` that writes the module from the template.
3. Add a test that fails when the template and module differ; document the script in the README.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Script exists and is documented
- [ ] Sync test fails when the template is edited without regenerating
- [ ] Landing page renders the same as today

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-pool
```

---
